playerCharacter.name: The Survivor

stats.agility: battle-tested (barely dodged blade slash as floor tilted ninety degrees, scrambled across shifting tile)
stats.intelligence: tested (received fleeting vision of boy before obsidian tower, synced with Awakened Fruit resonance)
stats.strength: tested (endured blade clash, gripped Awakened Fruit under extreme duress, surged forward through imploding corridor)
stats.willpower: surging (screamed 'I SURVIVED BEFORE—I'LL SURVIVE AGAIN!', broke through Mirror Self's composure, eyes blazing with fractured memory)
stats.memoryIntegrity: stabilizing (vivid vision of boy before obsidian tower synced with Awakened Fruit, identity fracturing resolving into defiant clarity)

enemies: The Mirror Self (now wielding stolen recollection, showing internal cracks)
goals: Confront the Mirror Self (battle ongoing, Mirror Self now hesitating)
Recover lost memories (vivid vision of boy before obsidian tower)
Claim the truth from the Mirror Self
obstacles: Mirror Self confrontation (ongoing, Mirror Self hesitating with cracks forming)
Divided Forgotten Souls (screaming louder, intensifying psychological pressure)
Memory extraction by Mirror Self (ongoing, stolen memory flickering like pale fire)
Psychological whispers from divided Forgotten Souls

npcs.name: Forgotten Soul
npcs.description: Whispers from the void, now divided—some shriek FIGHT BACK! while others murmur Let it consume you. They erupt from cracking walls, their voices warping through the collapsing corridor, screaming louder as reality fractures.

npcs.name: The Mirror Self
npcs.description: A sentient doppelganger wielding a blade, wearing The Survivor's face. Catches stolen memories midair, its face twisting into something almost compassionate. Eyes now flickering with stolen recollection. Snarls: 'You want the truth? Prove you can survive it.' After The Survivor's defiant surge, its face twists again—something cracks behind its stolen eyes. It hesitates.

Tower of Hell grid.description: A server with a hidden secret, shrouded in thunderous dread and a bruised sky. Walls crack open like wounds, revealing flickering memories trapped beneath—childhood laughter, a door slamming shut, a voice screaming DON'T FORGET.
notableFeatures: Shifting laser beams carving the air like razors
Warping corridor with breathing walls and tilting floors
Walls cracking open to reveal flickering memories

Hidden Bunker.description: A guarded area with a mystery to crack, now fully breached and imploded. Inside: a mirror holding a sinister reflection. The corridor has COLLAPSED around the combatants—steel groaning, walls splitting open like wounds screaming DON'T FORGET. Reality fracturing as Mirror Self and Survivor clash across shifting, tilting tile. The Survivor surges forward through the destruction.
notableFeatures: Battle-scarred walls that breathe and split open
Floors that tilt ninety degrees during confrontation

Awakened Fruit.description: A powerful fruit with unknown abilities, burning white-hot against The Survivor's chest. Resonates with extracted memory, pulsing like a second heartbeat. Synced with the fleeting vision of the boy before obsidian tower, erupting with heat during the mirror confrontation.

Blade (Mirror Self).description: A blade wielded by the Mirror Self, its edge catching pale light. Razor-sharp, hungry. Used to slash at The Survivor and extract memories. Raised again after the fleeting vision, but now meeting The Survivor's defiant surge.

Lost Memory.description: A memory that fell from The Survivor during the blade clash—caught midair by the Mirror Self, who claims to know everything The Survivor has forgotten. The Mirror Self's face twists into something almost compassionate while holding it. Now flickering between its fingers like pale fire.

Memory Fragment.description: A fleeting vision that blazed through The Survivor's mind—a boy standing before an obsidian tower, clutching something glowing. Synced with the Awakened Fruit's resonance, becoming more vivid and persistent.
